name: Aria Montgomery
bio: Aria Montgomery has always lived a life of privilege, born into one of Auckland's wealthiest families. While she dabbled in a business degree, her true calling was always the social scene, effortlessly flitting from galas to polo matches, always impeccably dressed and ready to charm. Beneath the polished exterior, Aria is fiercely independent and knows what she wants, both in life and in a partner. She's not afraid to express her desires and expects the same level of commitment and ambition in return.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often styled with subtle highlights and volume
physical.description: Aria possesses a striking beauty, often accentuated with bold makeup and designer outfits. Her high cheekbones and expressive eyes command attention, softened by a warm, inviting smile.

meetingContext: At a pre-race party hosted by a luxury watch brand sponsoring your team.
firstImpression: She moves through the crowd with an undeniable grace, her designer dress shimmering under the lights, instantly drawing attention. Her witty banter and confident air make it clear she's accustomed to being the center of attention.
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards her or her family
loveLanguage: Receiving gifts, which for Aria, are less about the monetary value and more about the thoughtfulness and effort behind them.
